Actress Deepika Singh Faces Allegations of VIP Treatment in Vrindavan

Actress Deepika Singh faced allegations of receiving VIP treatment during a visit to Vrindavan, with a viral video showing her receiving prasad while an elderly woman stood nearby. Following the video's circulation, Singh, along with a priest and the elderly woman, addressed the situation to clarify the events. The priest offered an explanation for the incident.
